identity.codeVersionMeaning: wherever the protocol (decisions line, resetRule) says codeVersion, it means modelIdentity v2's 64-hex producer closure hash, not payload.codeVersion
identity.releasePin: payload.codeVersion stays the deploy SHA (the DB-enforced release pin); it is recorded per readback, not part of the bound identity, and a change of it alone does not reset this scope
identity.pinRule: FIXTURE: fictional pin for offline tests; protocol identical to SCOPE-AMENDED.json

protocol.decisions: TJ direct pop-ups 2026-10-26 (D1-D5, FORGE-QUAL/TJ-DECISIONS-RECORDED.md) as amended by TJ pop-up 2026-11-21 relayed by Chef: Option B (every scored skater target, extends D2), identity fix (stable closure-hash codeVersion), D4 amended for overlay participation and per-target thresholds; part B rulings B1-B8 (relative dMSE, RSO-only claim, per-target minimums, bounded final look, every admitted game, per-start T-30 readbacks, served-value surface reset, F/D fallback), TJ pop-up 2026-11-21, recorded in rso-review-scope-2026-11-21/SCOPE-AMENDMENT.md

rso.consumer: Detailed RSO (rosterScheduleData/planning.ts, consumer rso, overlay applied)

claim.startChart: not claimed; Start Chart has no use gate and does not apply the RSO overlay
claim.perTarget: each target is its own claim and its own RsoTargetUseReview; league points show only when every weighted target passes

sealed.rule: no issued-row, readback or outcome reads for these dates; never used to choose target, threshold or method

population.source: forge_game_revisions selected by read_forge_game_revisions, horizon_games = 1, admitted by Detailed RSO with the RSO participation overlay
population.games: every scheduled game of the slate with an admitted Detailed revision carrying the pinned identity (no canary restriction)
population.rows: every skater row RSO serves at the readback, i.e. rows whose binding carries participationLineage forge-rso-participation-overlay-v1:skater@<revisionId> and conditioning rso_participation_overlay; unconditional, so a skater who does not dress settles at actual 0
population.excluded: rows withheld at the readback (stale_source, incomplete_refresh, missing_target) are counted and reported, never scored
population.firstSlate: first slate after the identity-fix release whose revisions carry this scope's pinned identity, and after this scope's hash is recorded

milestone.finalLook: first slate >= 14 at which every target still running has reached minSettledRows; a target not there by slate 28 ends inconclusive

readback.timing: one RSO read per distinct scheduled start time of the slate, at that start's T-30 min (after each game's own T-60 capture acknowledgement and publication, deadline.ts ACK_LEAD_MINUTES); that value is the evaluated prediction for the games starting then
readback.coverage: each read requests the whole skater pool of the games it covers, so every issued skater row can be admitted and read back
readback.approval: each slate's read plan (routes, start-time groups, count) needs TJ's approval before it runs
readback.integrity: the RSO readback equals the overlay recomputed from the frozen revision line and the readback's recorded participation sources, to tolerance

settlement.actual: per target, see targets.*.actual; penalty-shot goals/shots (goals_ps, shots_ps) are excluded, as the model does not project them, and reported descriptively
rules: recordedAt after puck drop and after issue
a later repair is settlement version 2, never an overwrite

baselines.definition: player's season-to-date per-game rate of the target at the revision cutoffAt, times the same overlay indicator the row was served with (1 for _playing, 0 for _out); fewer than 5 games played: the season-to-date per-game rate of his position group (F or D)
baselines.role: non-inferiority comparator; shares participation with FORGE so the comparison isolates the rate model

baselines.definition: previous verified producer closure's revisions for the same games, where they exist

metrics.calibrationSlope: OLS slope of actual on predicted, per target
metrics.deltaMseRel: (MSE(FORGE) - MSE(season_rate)) / MSE(season_rate), 95% bootstrap interval clustered by player and game, per target
metrics.integrity: share of served rows whose readback matches the recomputed overlay value; identity_mismatch and readback_unissued counts

looks.purpose: stop for harm only, per target

looks.passIf: every threshold of that target, plus integrity

protocol.resetRule: ends this scope: any change of the producer closure hash (codeVersion), configurationHash or artifactHash; any change of the participation method id; or any change of the served-value surface outside the closure (sha256 of web/lib/projections/consumerRevisionAdmission.ts, rsoParticipationOverlay.ts and rsoParticipationNotes.ts, recorded per readback). A deploy whose closure and surface hashes are unchanged is the same identity and does not reset. A new scope is declared before its first slate.
protocol.noTuning: no method, threshold or population change between looks; failed literal gates are reported beside any owner exception

participation.issuedValue: stats[target] = the revision's frozen 'if he plays' line (conditionalStats) x 1 when the basis ends in _playing, x 0 otherwise, as the overlay computes it at the readback from the frozen revision and the read-time participation sources
participation.record: per row: basis, conflict flag, line-role flag, the overlay's last changes [time, source id], and whether the player dressed (forge_player_game_strength row with toi > 0)
participation.report: bias and dMSE stratified by basis, and the basis-vs-dressed confusion table; descriptive, not gates

bootstrap.appliesTo: metrics.deltaMseRel per target and look (gate and harm stop); bias and slope intervals from the same draws are descriptive

seed.derivation: baseSeed = first 16 hex chars of sha256(utf8('forge-qual-bootstrap-v1:' + the pre-bootstrap protocolHash)), read as an unsigned 64-bit integer; the pre-bootstrap protocolHash was fixed before any qualifying data existed
seed.streams: each (target, look) uses its own seed: first 16 hex chars of sha256(utf8('forge-qual-bootstrap-v1:' + baseSeedHex + ':' + targetKey + ':' + lookId)), lookId 'look1' or 'final', so results do not depend on target order

rng.algorithm: xoshiro256** (Blackman and Vigna 2018), state initialised by four successive splitmix64 outputs from the stream seed
rng.uniformIndex: index in [0, n): draw x = next u64; reject while x >= 2^64 - (2^64 mod n); return x mod n

clustering.scheme: two-way crossed pigeonhole bootstrap over game x player (Owen 2007)
clustering.why: errors share game effects (pace, opponent, score state) and player effects (the rate model's per-player error); resampling either alone understates the interval
clustering.clusters: the distinct gameIds and distinct NHL playerIds among that target's scored rows at that look, each sorted ascending numerically
clustering.perReplicate: draw G game indices then P player indices with replacement (G, P = cluster counts), in that order; a row's weight = (times its game drawn) x (times its player drawn); rows of weight 0 drop out
clustering.statistic: deltaMseRel = (sum w*(pred_FORGE - actual)^2 - sum w*(pred_baseline - actual)^2) / sum w*(pred_baseline - actual)^2

interval.quantileRule: on the finite replicate values sorted ascending (m of them), the q-quantile is linear interpolation at position h = (m - 1) * q (Hyndman-Fan type 7)
interval.nonFinite: a replicate whose baseline sum is 0 is non-finite, excluded and counted; more than 1% non-finite makes that target inconclusive at that look

bootstrap.pointEstimate: the unweighted full-sample statistic, not the bootstrap mean
bootstrap.precision: IEEE-754 double arithmetic, sums in row order sorted by (gameId, playerId) ascending
